title: Turtles: The Flash
description:
This mod was made in 3 hours for a youtube challenge.
It adds in a "flash" costume as well as a speedforce superpower system. 
these include, super speed, lightning throw, and the ability to increase your speed.
body:
Welcome to- the flash. The costumes and powers are mixed between different iterations, the costume designs are more "classic age" while the powers work slightly more like the CW. 

Due to my limited time, i could not add everything. But i think i got a good amount of the basics. Currently (and probably permanitly) the mod adds: 

The flash (costume) Classic version - Cowl, main suit piece, leggings, boots. 

The Reverse flash "Professor Zoom" (costume) Classic version - Cowl, main suit piece, leggings, boots. 

Empty Vial + Darkmatter Vial = use an empty vial during a thunderstorm to capture darkmatter, and then use that with a Collider to create a speed force storm. You'll then be granted speed powers.

Speedforce powers: 
Super speed - Run at superhuman speeds, can increase 4 times before you burst into flames from friction. 
Regeneration - by default, everything about you is sped up, your body regenerates faster! 
(Suit powers, or- powers that need suits to work)
Full speed - Run even faster, maxing out at speed 255 (vanilla cap) 
Throw lightning - now able to contain your lightning, you can throw it by pressing "R" (configurable in the menu)

This mod is the first in a series of mods i wish to make where i cover pretty much any superhero i can think of. should be fun. i might call it, the "3 hour force" or something.
